feat(mainnet+bot): fresh mainnet proof under fixed contract, /importkey

Landing page FAQ now links a mainnet deploy + guarded spend performed
under the agent_pkh-fixed validator, replacing the links to the old
vulnerable contract's transactions from before the fix.

Telegram bot: added /importkey <privateKey> [perTxCap] [dailyCap] so
a user can register with a key they already control instead of only
being offered one the bot generates. The bot still signs on their
behalf during use - that part is unavoidable for a chat interface with
no wallet-extension access - but the user now always has their own
copy of the key from the start rather than depending on bot storage
for it. Best-effort deletes the message containing the raw key.

feat(swaps): auto-anchor proof on completion + reusable deliverable modal

- Extract deliverable submission into AddDeliverableModal so it works inline on the messages page without redirecting to the swap page
- Add AnchorProofModal: undismissable CIP-30 signing dialog; closes immediately after tx submission, polling happens silently in background
- Auto-trigger anchor modal when swap reaches COMPLETED + proof PENDING
- Add PendingAnchorChecker (+ SSR-safe loader) mounted in the app shell to detect unanchored proofs on login/navigation and prompt the user
- Add GET /api/proofs/pending returning PENDING/FAILED proofs for the current user
- Fix "View Proof (Cardano)" always disabled in messages panel: include proof fields in messages API query; check chainStatus === "ANCHORED"
- Point Cardano proof link to cardanoscan.io explorer instead of the internal swap page
- Add withTimeout helper wrapping BrowserWallet.enable() (30 s) and wallet.signTx() (120 s) so unresponsive extensions (old Lace on Edge) surface a clear error instead of hanging indefinitely
style(ui): improve light theme colors, hierarchy, and component polish
Swapping mock data for real data

fix(dashboard): perfect-match popup shows once ever per account

Replaced sessionStorage with a user-scoped localStorage key (pm_shown_<userId>) so the popup is not blocked by stale session data from a previous user or tab, and persists across browser sessions. Also fixed useEffect([router]) → useEffect([], cancelled) to prevent double-runs on navigation, and removed the redundant warm-up fetch from onboarding whose result was immediately discarded.

Merge pull request #3 from opa1/staging: fix(missions): stop hiding missions from the board by status

fix(missions): stop hiding missions from the board by status

fix(missions): stop hiding missions from the board by status

The Missions page and Recent Missions only ever selected 'open' and 'completed' rows, but tasks.status takes five values. A mission that got claimed (all slots taken) or submitted for review silently vanished from the board, as did anything the deadline cron closed as 'cancelled'.

Both listing queries now apply no status filter at all — nothing is dropped from the board. "Open Only" remains the one view that filters, and it does so on request.

BountyCard badges every non-open state instead of just completed: claimed -> In progress, submitted -> In review, completed -> Completed, cancelled -> Expired or Cancelled depending on whether the deadline has passed. Only genuinely closed missions are dimmed; in-flight ones keep full opacity.

"Open First" used to work by sorting status descending, which happened to put 'open' above 'completed' alphabetically. That breaks with 'claimed' and 'submitted' in the mix and PostgREST can't express a CASE ranking, so the ordering moves into a stable STATUS_RANK sort in the store.

deadline_passed is derived in the stores rather than in BountyCard because the React compiler rejects reading the clock during render.
